name: Cyclazodone
summary: Cyclazodone is a stimulant substance belonging to the Substituted aminorexes, 4-oxazolidinone chemical class.

tolerance.buildUp: develops with prolonged and repeated use

pharmacology.text: Structural congeners of pemoline have been described as "excitants with unique properties distinguishing them from the sympathomimetic amines" whilst displaying less stimulatory activity and toxicity compared to amphetamine.

uses.text: Cyclazodone is a centrally acting stimulant drug developed by American Cyanamid Company in the 1960s.

summaryZh: 環唑酮（英語：Cyclazodone）是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式為C12H12N2O2，1960年代由美國氰胺公司作為興奮劑研發。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Stimulants of its kind can cause sleeplessness, restlessness, anxiety, a fast heartbeat, high blood pressure and loss of appetite, and can lead to dependence. High amounts can cause overheating, paranoia, psychosis and seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。這類興奮劑可能造成失眠、坐立不安、焦慮、心跳加快、血壓升高與食慾減退，並可能導致依賴。大量使用可能造成體溫過高、妄想、精神病症狀與癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。这类兴奋剂可能造成失眠、坐立不安、焦虑、心跳加快、血压升高与食欲减退，并可能导致依赖。大量使用可能造成体温过高、妄想、精神病症状与癫痫发作。

fact.en: It is a relative of pemoline, a stimulant once used for ADHD that was withdrawn in many countries after rare cases of liver failure.
fact.zh: 它是匹莫林的近親。匹莫林是曾用於治療注意力不足過動症的興奮劑，因罕見的肝衰竭案例而在許多國家下架。
fact.zhHans: 它是匹莫林的近亲。匹莫林是曾用于治疗注意力不足过动症的兴奋剂，因罕见的肝衰竭案例而在许多国家下架。
